title: Verify: World repository and read handler unit tests
summary: Unit tests proving the four world read endpoints respond from repository files.
description: Unit tests written from the requirement spec with temp-dir files and httptest only. Context: GET /worlds, /worlds/{id}, /worlds/{id}/game and /worlds/{id}/round/current respond from files. Expected result: all listed tests pass.
acceptance_criteria: Given worlds/the-boys-room/world.yaml, when GET /api/v1/worlds runs, then a JSON array containing that world id is returned
Given an unknown or unsafe world id, when GET /api/v1/worlds/{id} runs, then 404 is returned
Given round directories, when GET /api/v1/worlds/{id}/round/current runs, then the highest-numbered round with id, number, status, starts_at and ends_at is returned
Given game content for the world, when GET /api/v1/worlds/{id}/game runs, then the world YAML and scenes are returned as JSON

preserve: Existing player session handlers in backend/internal/player

technical_constraints: Go 1.22, chi router, no database; persistent data lives in Git as Markdown/YAML
Git writes go through an interface wrapping the Git CLI
definition_of_done: Listed tests pass via the unit command

steps.action: Write test TestList_And_Get: t.TempDir with worlds/the-boys-room/world.yaml; List returns [the-boys-room]; Get("missing") and Get("../x") return ErrNotFound.
Write test TestCurrentRound_HighestNumber: write round-0000001 and round-0000002 round.yaml; CurrentRound returns number 2 with status and parsed times.
Write test TestHandlers_StatusAndJSON: httptest + chi router; GET /worlds, /worlds/the-boys-room, /game, /round/current return 200 JSON; unknown id returns 404.
